note: Large frontcountry campground in mature spruce forest on the edge of Waskesiu townsite, Prince Albert NP: back-in sites of various sizes on raised gravel pads, shared camp kitchens, and ten oTENTiks in R-Loop. Walking distance to the townsite's services. --Claude
